wire.t: Carson Beck was ruled out Saturday with back spasms, so Arizona started 40-year-old Josh Johnson against Kansas City, its fourth starting quarterback in four games. Johnson went 18 of 31 for 155 yards and a touchdown for 12.2 points. Bill_Buttlicker added him at 9:02 AM Sunday and dropped Justin Fields to do it.

Patrick Mahomes threw three touchdowns, two to Travis Kelce, in a 34-7 win over Arizona: 30.96 for Hold My DK and 26.9 for Kraft for Cash. Emmett Johnson ran 23 times for 105 yards and scored for the fourth straight game, 26.3 for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix.

Rookie Jonah Coleman ran for a season-best 111 yards and three touchdowns in Denver's 38-24 win over Las Vegas, 35.4 points for Kraft for Cash. Fernando Mendoza threw for 267 yards and three scores for 31.88 on the I Chase Brown Kids taxi squad. Courtland Sutton was held without a catch on two targets in the Bourbon Lover lineup.

Dak Prescott threw four touchdowns and ran for another in Dallas' 51-30 win over Tennessee, 44.9 for Bourbon Lover in a loss. CeeDee Lamb had 132 yards (28.7, Kraft for Cash), George Pickens 102 (22.3, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix) and Javonte Williams two scores (24.1, I Chase Brown Kids). Cam Ward added 28.22 for I Chase Brown Kids.

Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and two touchdowns in Carolina's 35-33 win over Baltimore, 29.0 for Hold My DK. Derrick Henry scored and was then evaluated for a concussion and did not return; Hold My DK had him in the lineup for 19.6.

Brock Purdy threw three first-half touchdowns, two to George Kittle, in a 35-10 win over Minnesota Sunday night. Purdy scored 28.2 for Catfan94’s Farm Team, Kittle 18.4 for Hold My DK, and Mike Evans 22.4 for Jefferson’s Reserve.

Bengals at Commanders tonight decides two games and moves a third. Still to play: Ja'Marr Chase (LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix); Jayden Daniels, Chase Brown and Mike Gesicki (I Chase Brown Kids); Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins (The Champ); Samaje Perine (StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte); Stefon Diggs (Dude, Your Getting a Dell). Burrow leads the NFL with 27 touchdown passes.

Sunday moves: Bill_Buttlicker added Josh Johnson for Justin Fields at 9:02 AM. Dalton Kincaid was ruled Out and stayed in the OBJAY lineup for 0.0. ManicOrientals left Dawson Knox (5.6) and Justice Hill (17.1) on the Asian Jim bench. jmello16 is still at $0 of FAAB spent.

stories.title: Monday night decides it: I Chase Brown Kids trails LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix by 44.14 with three players left
stories.dek: Jayden Daniels, Chase Brown and Mike Gesicki against Ja'Marr Chase. The projections say LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix by 13.35, which is a lot closer than a 41.0-point line.
body: Four of the six Week 11 games are done and a fifth is done in every way but the paperwork. The one that isn't: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix 140.56, I Chase Brown Kids 96.42, with Bengals at Commanders tonight. ZachCarroll09 has three players left: Jayden Daniels, Chase Brown and Mike Gesicki. Catfan94 has one: Ja'Marr Chase. Run Sleeper's projections through this league's scoring and it comes out 163.91 to 150.56. That's a 13.35-point win for the 9‑1 team, which would be its seventh straight, but it's not a cover of 41.0.

For I Chase Brown Kids to win, those three need to outscore Chase by 44.14. Daniels is projected for 26.27, Brown 17.03, Gesicki 10.84 and Chase 23.35. ZachCarroll09 needs a Daniels ceiling game and Chase to have a quiet one. It's happened. It's not happening tonight, probably, but it's happened.

How'd it get this close? Josh Allen scored 14.16 with two interceptions in a 26-9 win over Miami, Isaiah Likely got 5.0 at tight end with Brock Bowers Out, and Ollie Gordon II got 9.2 at superflex with Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love on bye. Jahmyr Gibbs (28.8), Emmett Johnson (26.3), George Pickens (22.3) and Jameson Williams (20.3) did the rest. On the other side, Cam Ward scored 28.22 and Javonte Williams 24.1, while Fernando Mendoza threw three touchdowns for 31.88 on the taxi squad.

The other two Monday games: The Champ leads me 87.56 to 60.00 with Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins left, and I have Samaje Perine. Hold My DK leads Dude, Your Getting a Dell 142.50 to 63.34 with Stefon Diggs left for Br0phy. Hold My DK goes to 10‑1 tonight. Dude, Your Getting a Dell goes to 0‑11. And the guy who writes this site is going to 3‑8.

stories.title: Kraft for Cash scores 197.20, the fourth-highest score in league history, and beats OBJAY by 105.56
stories.dek: Jonah Coleman, CeeDee Lamb, Travis Kelce and Justin Herbert all go over 26. OBJAY started a tight end who was ruled Out.
body: BTaylor1 had the week of the year. Kraft for Cash beat OBJAY 197.20 to 91.64: Jonah Coleman 35.4 on three touchdowns, CeeDee Lamb 28.7, Travis Kelce 26.9 with two touchdowns from Mahomes, Justin Herbert 26.44, DJ Moore 21.6, Bryce Young 19.96 and Tetairoa McMillan 18.1. Jack Bech scored 20.8 on the taxi squad and nobody even noticed. Only Catfan94's 243.58 and 232.54 and jrsmith1391's 198.64 have ever been higher.

Kraft for Cash goes to 7‑4 with 1522.10 points. And it's got three starting quarterbacks for two spots now that Anthony Richardson Sr. starts for the Colts. Next week is Catfan94’s Farm Team, which will be 8‑3, for what's basically the No. 3 seed.

OBJAY is the other side of it. Dalton Kincaid was Doubtful all week, got ruled Out, and stayed in the lineup for 0.0. Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee were on the bench. Ted Hurst III scored 21.1 on the taxi squad while Luther Burden III (2.8) and Emeka Egbuka (3.3) started. Geno Smith scored 25.44 in the Jets' win at the Chargers and it didn't matter.
JAY2913 is about to be 4‑7 with three weeks left. Next week is Asian Jim, which also lost Sunday. Loser of that one is done.

stories.title: I scored 60.00, the lowest score of Week 11, and next week I play the 0‑10 team
stories.dek: Josh Johnson was the right call. Everything else on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte was not.
body: Let me take a victory lap for exactly one decision. At 9:02 Sunday morning I dropped Justin Fields, who's Patrick Mahomes' backup, and picked up Josh Johnson, because Carson Beck was ruled out Saturday with back spasms and Arizona was starting a 40-year-old. Johnson went 18 of 31 for 155 yards and a touchdown. 12.2 points. In a superflex league where I had zero starting quarterbacks, that's a win. That's the lap.

Here's the rest. 60.00 points, lowest in the league this week, 3.34 behind Dude, Your Getting a Dell. I started Ashton Dulin at receiver for 4.5 while Devaughn Vele scored 13.6 on my bench. I put Chris Rodriguez Jr., a running back, at superflex for 6.1 because I had no second quarterback. Tyler Allgeier scored 2.8. Samaje Perine plays tonight and I need him to outscore Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins by 27.56. He won't.

If Perine gets less than 0.77 tonight, my 60.00 replaces jrsmith1391's 60.76 as the fifth-lowest score in league history. I already own the third-lowest. I'd love to own a top-five high score instead, but I don't have the quarterbacks for it.

Week 12 is StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte against Dude, Your Getting a Dell, 3‑8 against 0‑11, Bill_Buttlicker against Br0phy. Drake Maye is still Out, Jalen Hurts is on IR, and Josh Johnson starts only if Carson Beck's back doesn't loosen up. I have 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts. I would trade a lot of them for a guaranteed win over the winless team.

stories.title: Three weeks left: Catfan94’s Farm Team is 8‑3, Kraft for Cash is 7‑4, and Jefferson’s Reserve gets to 6‑5
stories.dek: Asian Jim and OBJAY both lost and play each other next week. The Champ is about to be 6‑5 and gets Hold My DK.
body: Once Monday's games are final, here's where it lands. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 10‑1, unless I Chase Brown Kids pulls off a 44.14-point comeback. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 8‑3 after beating Asian Jim 140.98 to 81.94, with Brock Purdy at 28.2 and Baker Mayfield at 22.58 on a foot nobody was sure about Saturday. Kraft for Cash is 7‑4.

Then it gets tight. The Champ should be 6‑5 tonight. Jefferson’s Reserve is 6‑5 after beating Bourbon Lover 127.00 to 115.20 even though Dak Prescott scored 44.9 against it. Asian Jim is 5‑6 after the Daniel Jones release left ManicOrientals with Tyler Shough and a bench that outscored two starters. OBJAY is 4‑7, and I Chase Brown Kids will be too unless tonight goes crazy.
Points for is the tiebreaker. The Champ has 1414.72 before tonight, Jefferson’s Reserve 1380.50, Asian Jim 1273.92. TJohn91 is going to add Burrow and Higgins on top of that.

Week 12: Kraft for Cash vs Catfan94’s Farm Team for the No. 3 seed. The Champ vs Hold My DK. Jefferson’s Reserve vs I Chase Brown Kids. OBJAY vs Asian Jim, where the loser is basically done. Bourbon Lover vs LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. And StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte vs Dude, Your Getting a Dell, which nobody is watching.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker built a superflex roster with no quarterbacks and 12 first-round picks. Pick one, son.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya says you don't get to cry about Drake Maye when you never bought a backup.
body: I want to be fair to the man who runs this site. Losing Drake Maye isn't a bad decision. That happens to every roster in football, and nobody gets to blame a manager for it. What he did after it is a different story.

Here's the quarterback room for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte as of Sunday morning. Maye, Out. Justin Fields, Kansas City's backup. Jalon Daniels, Tampa Bay's fourth-stringer, and Baker Mayfield is expected to play. Shedeur Sanders on the taxi squad. Jalen Hurts on IR. In a league where you start two quarterbacks, that's zero. Zero. When I played, if you showed up to camp without a helmet, you sat. He showed up without two.

Meanwhile jmello16 has five quarterbacks, I Chase Brown Kids has six, and Kraft for Cash has three starters for two spots. Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts. He's 3‑7 and 10‑28 all time. You can't hoard draft capital forever and call it a plan. Go buy a quarterback. Use a pick. That's what they're for. Toughen up and spend.

columns.title: 5 Sunday morning moves from Holden McGroin, who drafts quarterbacks by jersey color
columns.dek: Kickoff is at 1:00. Holden McGroin has been up since 4:00 and his advice has gotten worse every hour.
body: 1. JAY2913, keep Dalton Kincaid in. Doubtful isn't No. It's Maybe with a frown. I once started a guy listed Out because 'Out' could mean 'out there, getting open.' He did not play. I lost by 40. I stand by the reasoning.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, Drake Maye is Out, so start Justin Fields. What do you mean he's the backup? Backups play all the time. Patrick Mahomes has to sneeze eventually. Ride the sneeze.
3. ManicOrientals, you picked up Dawson Knox, so start him. You have Trey McBride? Start both. Start three tight ends. The more tight ends you start, the tighter your lineup. That's just physics.

4. Br0phy, you're up 10.1 to 0.0. Ask the commissioners if you can end the game early. Catfan94 and TJohn91 will say no, but the mercy rule has to start somewhere, and it should start with the 0‑10 team.

5. jrsmith1391, Baker Mayfield is wearing new cleats. New cleats mean a new man. Double-start him. I don't know if Sleeper allows that. Try it anyway and report back. I'm told this is how innovation happens.

columns.title: Josh Johnson is 40 and scored 12.2. That's 0.305 points per year, a league record I just invented.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot ran Sunday through the spreadsheet and is filing it as peer-reviewed.
body: Bill_Buttlicker picked up Josh Johnson at 9:02 AM and Johnson scored 12.2 by 4:00. That's seven hours from waiver wire to production, or 1.74 points per hour of roster time, the best rate of any quarterback on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte this year. Drake Maye's rate this week is 0.0 per hour, so by my model Johnson is infinitely better than Maye, which I'm told is not how dynasty works.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte scored 60.00 and Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored 63.34. That's a 3.34-point gap. Br0phy is 0‑10 and Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑7, so by points per win, Bill_Buttlicker's 3 wins are worth 3.34 fewer points than Br0phy's 0 wins. I've divided by zero to confirm it and the spreadsheet agrees, briefly, before it closes itself.

Kraft for Cash scored 197.20 against OBJAY's 91.64. That's 2.15 times as many points. Dalton Kincaid scored 0.0 at tight end, so Kraft for Cash outscored OBJAY's tight end by a ratio of infinity. Two infinities in one week. I'm requesting a bigger spreadsheet.

Dak Prescott has scored 44.9 and 45.42 in back-to-back weeks for Bourbon Lover, and Bourbon Lover lost both. That's 90.32 points for 0 wins, a 0.0 conversion rate. Courtland Sutton contributed 0.0 on two targets, which is a 100% match with the conversion rate. I call that synergy.

exits.t: Scored 13.6 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench in Week 11 while Ashton Dulin started and scored 4.5. Bill_Buttlicker found time Sunday morning to pick up a 40-year-old quarterback and not to swap one receiver. Vele has requested a manager who reads the whole lineup.

Scored 17.1 on the Asian Jim bench in Week 11 while Kyle Monangai started and scored 1.8. Asian Jim lost by 59.04. Last Monday he helped win a game on Monday night; this week he watched one from the bench. Would like a flex spot or a new address.

Scored 21.1 on the OBJAY taxi squad in Week 11 while Luther Burden III (2.8) and Emeka Egbuka (3.3) started at receiver. JAY2913 lost by 105.56. Hurst would like to be promoted from the taxi squad, or traded to a team that checks it.

Scored 16.72 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench in Week 11 while Trevor Lawrence started and scored 12.74. One of five quarterbacks on a roster that starts two. Has asked jmello16 to spend $1 of FAAB, or one trade, on literally anything.

Scored 16.2 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench in Week 11 while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 4.5. I Chase Brown Kids trails by 44.14 going into Monday night. Bateman has noted that 11.7 of that is his.

Scored 20.8 on the Kraft for Cash taxi squad in Week 11, more than four Kraft for Cash starters, in the best week the team has ever had. Nobody mentioned it. Would like to be on a team where 20.8 gets noticed.
